failed_or_abandoned: Mass interpolation of ln N linearly in ln m at fixed delta: neighbours beyond their kinematic ceiling are zero, collapsing the interpolated count to zero and producing bogus Higgsino windows (320/360 keV); replaced by interpolation at fixed xi = delta/delta_c(m) (leave-one-out ratios 1.01-1.18 for delta <= 366 keV, x32 at 380 keV over a factor-4 mass leap).

Higgsino counts as 0.0777 x N_iso (P007's isoscalar-equivalent coupling): overestimates P007's isovector-dominated grid by x1.3-1.85 because of the different form-factor node (P032); replaced by P007's own kernels plus live WimPyDD at 5/10 TeV (agreement 1.01-1.07 at 1 TeV).

Freeze-in s-integration truncated at sqrt(s) ~ 2m + 6T reproduced the massless closed form only to 0.68; extended to 40 T (1.000). A log(0) in the T_RH root finder returned NaN for m >= 1 TeV; guarded.
Single script with live WimPyDD inside took 6.8 min; the grids were moved into a cached helper so the main script runs in 3 min.

First-order delta effect on sigma_eff expected (~x delta/m ~ 1e-5) but found to cancel exactly at first order (chi2 in numerator and g_eff); the residual is second order (1e-10) and Y_eq changes at first order by <= 1.6e-5.
